awam-todo 0.7.1

- Major update with bilingual documentation: English (SKILL.md) and Chinese (SKILL.zh-CN.md) runbooks, optimization guides, and prompt references
- Added local web UI (server.py) with i18n support (English/Chinese), offline-safe
- Introduced capture service for global hotkey clipboard triage, managed via web UI or CLI, with system dialogs for confirmations
- New `triage` command: parses a single sentence to JSON add/update/status/delete suggestions, asks for confirmation if uncertain
- Enforced: CLI/API output is English, but follows user language in session; web UI language is user-switchable
- Expanded documentation on environment/configuration, editor and storage, and safe migration
- Various files reorganized and documentation improved for maintainability and user guidance
